subject: psychology
title: Research Methods: Ethics, Reliability & Validity
welcome_lead: Good data needs the BPS code, replicable tools and meaningful measurement.
meta_desc: A-Level Psychology research: ethics BPS, reliability test-retest inter-rater, validity types, sampling.
final_note: Reliability without validity is consistent nonsense; validity without ethics is harm.

concepts.def: Participant agrees knowing aims and procedure.
Consistency of measure across two occasions.
Whether the IV truly caused the DV.

walkthroughs.body_html: The BPS code rests on respect, competence, responsibility and integrity. Researchers need informed consent, the right to withdraw, protection from harm, confidentiality and a debrief. Deception is permitted only when justified and followed by debrief.

Test-retest: same participants twice, correlate scores; r > +0.80 is acceptable. Inter-rater: two observers code the same behaviour; agreement should also exceed +0.80. Split-half reliability checks internal consistency of questionnaires.

Face: looks right at a glance. Concurrent: correlates with established measure. Predictive: forecasts later behaviour. Ecological: generalises to real settings. Population: generalises to other people. Temporal: holds over time.
